scopeGuards: Combined VisitOSLO rows may resolve to several canonical physical places; do not create synthetic combined markers solely to mirror source presentation.
The existing gressholmen record is explicitly an exact named Gressholmen island polygon and does not absorb Heggholmen or Rambergøya.
Klosterruinene på Hovedøya resolves to hovedoya_kloster, while the separate Hovedøya source row resolves to hovedoya.
Steilene remains one archipelago-level candidate in this source pass unless coordinate research proves that no legitimate group geometry or stable group anchor exists.
Ingierstrand bad is a protected bathing complex; restaurant-only coordinates must not silently redefine the place scope.
Geographic location outside Oslo municipality is not an exclusion criterion when the current VisitOSLO Oslofjorden source explicitly includes the place.
